title: Change a run from the command line without editing the file
body: Deferred from the CLI design, 2026-10-08. Candidates: --data A=B to read every A.KEY from block B; --set A.K=V to replace one data value, V parsed as a michi value; --pool N to override the pipeline's pool for the machine at hand. All three act before resolve, on the scope, and apply to every pipeline in the file.
